question: If SUN is coded as 54, then how will MOON be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/783f10dee1bc187ab6697870a7588940923193d21ca30d083a130a8d9081429d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Positional value of S = 19, U = 21, N = 14

SUN = 19 + 21 + 14 = 54.

Similarly,

Place value of M = 13, O = 15, O = 15, N = 14

MOON = 13 + 15 + 15 + 14 = 57.

Hence, "57" is the correct answer.
